description: the correlation-scoped concurrency guard exists and is executable — dedup handles the sequential duplicate, the lock handles the concurrent one
CONCURRENCY: the first contender for a correlation_id acquires the lock (exit 0) — exactly one holder does the work
command: scripts/triage-run.sh --reset >/dev/null; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$?; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $R

description: CONCURRENCY: a second contender for a correlation_id already locked is rejected at exit 9 — two triggers for one incident never open two PRs
command: scripts/triage-run.sh --reset >/dev/null; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$?; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $R

description: CONCURRENCY: releasing the lock frees it so a later, non-overlapping run can proceed — the guard rejects OVERLAP, it does not permanently block the correlation_id
command: scripts/triage-run.sh --reset >/dev/null; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid dd-cid >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/triage-lock.sh --status --cid dd-cid

description: CONCURRENCY (true race): under five simultaneous acquirers for one correlation_id, EXACTLY ONE wins — the mkdir primitive is atomic, so no two loops ever run together
command: scripts/triage-run.sh --reset >/dev/null; T=$(mktemp); for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do ( scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid race >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo win >> "$T" ) & done; wait; N=$(wc -l < "$T" | tr -d ' '); rm -f "$T"; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid race >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $N

description: CONCURRENCY: two DIFFERENT correlation_ids lock independently — the guard is per-incident, so unrelated incidents triage in parallel without blocking each other
command: scripts/triage-run.sh --reset >/dev/null; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid cid-A >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/triage-lock.sh --acquire --cid cid-B >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$?; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid cid-A >/dev/null 2>&1; scripts/triage-lock.sh --release --cid cid-B >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $R
